description: Use this when the user wants to find a used car for sale in the Czech Republic — by brand, model, body type, fuel, gearbox, year, price, mileage, power, number of seats or town/region. Covers listings sellers published on AutoIsto directly and public listings from Czech car portals. Pass the criteria as ONE short phrase in Czech (Slovak also works), with numbers as the user said them and prices in CZK. Examples that are fully understood: "škoda octavia kombi nafta automat od 2017 do 350000 Kč", "suv automat do 600000 Kč", "bmw x5 diesel od 2019 do 1000000 Kč", "kombi do 250000 Kč Brno", "9 místná dodávka". Use at most ONE body type per call (kombi, SUV, sedan, hatchback, liftback, MPV, kupé, kabriolet, dodávka, pick-up); for two body types make two calls. Leave out filler and wishes that are not filters (auto, do města, spolehlivé) and equipment (tažné, panorama) — unknown words are not applied and are listed in notUnderstood. Returns up to 10 cars with price verdicts, what was understood, which criteria were relaxed when nothing matched exactly, which words were not applied, and a link to all results. Limits: only cars currently listed on AutoIsto (Czech Republic, prices in CZK); no new-car configurators, rentals, leasing offers or cars abroad; the offer changes daily, so a car may already be sold. Seat counts of 6+ are estimated from the model.

query.description: Concrete criteria in Czech or Slovak, e.g. "bmw x5 diesel od 2019 do 1000000 Kč" or "kombi do 250000 Kč Brno".

name: search_cars

cars.description: Up to 10 cars, AutoIsto's best-value order (closest to the budget when a budget was given).

comparableCars.description: How many comparable cars the saving is computed from.

id.description: Stable AutoIsto car id; pass it to get_car_details.

location.description: Town or district as stated in the listing.

mileageKm.description: Odometer in km; null = the seller did not state it.

priceNote.description: Caveat about the price taken from the ad (e.g. price without VAT, price with financing, damage mentioned), in Czech; null = plain price.

priceSavingCzk.description: How much below the median of comparable cars; only set when priceVerdict is below_market.

priceVerdict.description: AutoIsto price verdict against comparable cars (same model, similar year, mileage and version). null = not enough comparable cars, or the price is not a plain sale price.

source.description: Where the listing comes from (portal name, or AutoIsto for a seller's own listing).

url.description: Link to the car on www.autoisto.cz — show it to the user unchanged.

variant.description: Trim / engine as written by the seller, null when it only repeats the model.

notUnderstood.description: Words from the query that were NOT applied as filters (unknown words, two body types at once, equipment). Empty together with empty relaxed = the results match everything in the query.

relaxed.description: Criteria from the phrase dropped because nothing matched exactly, in Czech; the returned cars do NOT meet them.

totalMatches.description: How many cars in the offer match (after relaxing, if any). 0 = nothing matched even after relaxing.

understood.description: Filters from the phrase that the returned cars match, in Czech (e.g. Škoda, Octavia, cena do 300 000 Kč).

title: Search used cars
